subject: Model Commons triangulation: compare Claude, Codex and an existing native/local route under one typed task

body.objective: Exercise provider substitution as a measured semantic contract, not a provider preference.
required_actions: Choose one tiny non-destructive typed task with deterministic acceptance gates and run it independently through post-reset Claude and Codex.

If an existing installed native/local model route is registered, run the same task there. Use FPQ/SLI/Reason or other native model Powers only when their current registered runtime is already available; do not download a large model.

Normalize all three through the native AgentSession/ReceiptEnvelope contract and compare semantic outcome, provider/model identity, wall time, context bytes/tokens when available, external cost class, retries and evidence quality.
Run one provider-substitution replay: change carrier/model while preserving the WorkGraph obligation and prove lifecycle identity does not change.
Create routing factors only inside FactorValidityEnvelope bound to exact provider/model/runtime versions and task family.
body.acceptance: ProviderGraph receives an evidence-backed ranking for this task family while preserving that provider identity is evidence, never authority.
